result.title: Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC
result.summary: Reward-guided diffusion requires effective steering and correction of the bias introduced by approximate value functions. A Brownian example shows that SMC with full multinomial resampling at every step can require particle counts to grow linearly with guidance depth to maintain accuracy. We propose Stein Guidance, which combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction. Value-weighted selection from centered Gaussian candidates approximates gradient guidance in expectation, using as few as two queries per step. Centering stabilizes the local normalizer estimates, and the same queries yield an explicit path weight for correction. Under uniform value and spatial regularity bounds, we prove superpolynomial decay of finite-grid total variation error in the number of MH updates, with constants that do not grow with guidance depth. The error prefactor tends to zero as the value functions approach exact Doob values and the time grid is refined.

AI.brief_summary: 针对奖励引导扩散采样中近似值函数引入的偏差，以及每步全多项重采样的 SMC 粒子数须随引导深度线性增长的问题，提出无梯度 Stein Guidance：用中心化高斯候选的值加权选择近似梯度引导，并以整路径独立 Metropolis-Hastings 校正；在均匀值与空间正则假设下给出不随引导深度增长的误差界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「每步仅少量查询＋路径级 MH 校正替代逐步粒子重采样」的做法，可能为扩散式 latent 推理中沿轨迹施加价值引导、以粒子搜索筛选推理状态提供降低粒子数与计算成本的线索；但论文无多模态实验，与 LVR 的对应关系尚待核查。
